author: Marlon Chaviano
name: mobile-ionic-react
title: Mobile app with Ionic and React
description: Ionic with React and Capacitor: one web codebase for iOS, Android and PWA, with Ionic's mobile components and access to native APIs.
setupTasks: Capacitor: to test on a device, add the platform (`npx cap add ios` or `npx cap add android`) and then `npx cap sync`.
instructions:
## How to work here

- Use Ionic components (`IonPage`, `IonHeader`, `IonList`…) so the app looks native on each platform; pages go in `src/pages/`.
- Native APIs (camera, files, notifications) are used through Capacitor plugins, never with browser APIs that don't exist on mobile.
- After changing web code: `npm run build && npx cap sync`. Before finishing: `npm run build`.
